en: She stays as she is and moves her mouth as if she is talking.

tr: konuşur gibi ama farklı ağız hareketleriyle
en: She says "Hello, how are you?" and her mouth changes shape with each sound.
She stands up from her gaming chair while saying "Hello, how are you?"

tr: mikrafonu tutsun eline alsın fotoğraftaki mesela
en: She picks up the microphone from the desk and holds it in her hand.
She types on the keyboard.
She puts on headphones and listens to music.
She gets up and lies down on the sofa behind her.
She combs her hair.
She gets up and turns off the PC tower behind her.

tr: kameraya yaklaşıp ışığı kapatsın sadece onun yüzüne vuran influencer ışığını
en: She leans toward the camera and turns off the influencer light, the one that shines only on her face.
She takes the plush toy and hugs it.
She makes a butterfly shadow on the desk with her hands.

tr: çok oturan bir insan gibi esneme hareketleri yapabilir
en: She stretches like someone who has been sitting for a long time.

tr: kalksın koltuğa doğru giderken dans etsin
en: She gets up and dances while moving toward the sofa.

tr: mikrafonu düşürsün sonr aoflayarak tepki versi
en: She drops the microphone behind the desk, then reacts with an annoyed sigh.
Her outfit instantly changes into plaid pajamas.

tr: aikyo kasaya giderken kamera ona zoomlasın
en: She walks to the PC tower while the camera zooms in on her.
She goes to the window and closes the curtains.

tr: aikyo cebinden bir obje çıkartıp masaya koysın
en: She takes a phone out of her pocket and puts it on the desk with its back side facing up.

tr: fiyonkunu çıkarıp arkadaki koltuğa atsın koltukta gözüksün fiyonk
en: She takes off the bow on her chest and throws it onto the sofa behind her, where it stays visible.
